briefdescription.para: A linked-list with a custom, local allocator.

detaileddescription.para: Expose a std::list-like interface that owns and uses a custom LLVM-style allocator (e.g., BumpPtrAllocator), leveraging simple_ilist for the implementation details.
Because this list owns the allocator, calling splice() with a different list isn't generally safe. As such, splice has been left out of the interface entirely.
